'''Arankau''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] living on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]]. At young age, he became interested in [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that have settled in Rishi, believing them to eventually become aggressive. Arankau studied them and when they finally attacked, led dozens of Rishii against them, non-lethally wounding every one of the pirates. The Nova Blades never bothered Rishii again, nor did Arankau have to fight.<ref name="Arankau">{{TORcite||type=codex|Arankau}}</ref> In [[3637 BBY]] he welcomed [[Jakarro]], [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Alliance Commander|their companion]] to a Rishii village on the [[Sky Ridge Island]].<ref name="The Revanites Revealed" />
